about: The GPU SDK installers a Windows release build installs, each pinned to the SHA-256 of the vendor's own file (windows_toolkits.ps1 installs these and nothing else; the versions are the ones Blender pins in build_files/buildbot/config/blender_version.cmake, which gpu_sdk_pins.py judges after the install). An installer in the toolkits folder whose SHA-256 is not here is skipped; a pin whose installer is missing, or whose sha256 is still TBD, fails the toolkits stage. Record a sha256 only after the file matched its vendor's published checksum (or, for an installer with none, was taken from the vendor's own site) and its Authenticode signature is Valid.

installers.source: NVIDIA developer site, downloaded by the maintainer 2026-11-14 (56,524,128 bytes)

download.amd.com/developer/eula/rocm-hub (AMD's HIP SDK 7.1.1 for Windows 11, the only 7.1.1 package; licence accepted by the maintainer 2026-11-14). AMD publishes no checksum: 1,754,164,768 bytes as AMD's server reported, Authenticode checked at install, and gpu_sdk_pins.py must read 7.1.51803 from the installed hip_version.h before configuring

registrationcenter-download.intel.com (Intel Graphics Offline Compiler for OpenCL Code 2025.3.7, driver build 32.0.101.8424; Intel's EULA accepted by the maintainer 2026-11-14). Intel publishes no checksum: the file is the size Intel's server reports, Authenticode checked at install, and the registered ocloc.exe must report FileVersion 32.0.101.8424
